text:
Maya K.: Quick heads-up — running quantized bringup for redwood-7b-q4_0-rope on long-context tests (64k). Seeing intermittent KV-cache divergence / token-shifts after ~12k tokens. Repro below, anyone free to eyeball? :eyes:
Diego R.: Hmm that's around the same region we saw earlier but with different quant flags. Do you have the exact curl + config?
Maya K.: Paste:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-q4_0-rope","rope_scale":"linear","rope_alpha":1.2,"prompt":"<long 64k prompt>"}'
```
Samir P.: Can you attach the exact prompt or a minimal repro? Hard to debug without the repeating pattern that triggers it.
Maya K.: Minimal repro attached inline: repeating paragraph ~500x => ends up shifting tokens at iteration ~12037. Log snippet: 
```
[kv] write_index=12287 next_index=0 delta=-12287
[kv] cache_reset: reason=rope_wraparound
output: expected '... on the mat' got '... on mat'
```
Diego R.: That `next_index=0` is suspicious — sounds like wrap to zero not handled by `kv-offset` arithmetic after quantized kernel path.
Samir P.: Did you test with fp16 / q8? i.e., rule out quantization noise vs index arithmetic bug.
Maya K.: Right — fp16 run shows no shift. q4_0 reproduces every ~12000-13000 token window. q8_0 intermittent but rarer. :thinking:
eval-bot: regression-alert: perplexity +18% at token window 12k-13k on long-context eval set (run-id: eval/2026-06-12/kv-long)
Diego R.: Could be two separate issues: (1) RoPE scaling/alpha changing index mapping over wrap; (2) quantized kernel modulo math losing high bits. Both plausible.
Maya K.: Proposed next steps: (a) run q4_1 and q8_0 full reproducibility checks, (b) add `--kv-debug` to log raw kv indices, (c) push reproducer to eng-ml/kv-repros and link the exact prompt, (d) if repro confirmed, open an infra bug with `kv_index` trace and quant config.
Samir P.: I'll spin up q4_1 + fp16 runs on dedicated pool, logging `kv_index` and `rope-pos` per step. ETA 3 hours.
Diego R.: I can review the kernel modulo ops; expecting a cast truncation in `batch_index = (base+offset) % buffer_len` where base is int64 vs int32 in quant path.
Maya K.: Filed issue: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MLINF-4512 with repro link. Tagging @Diego R. and @Samir P. I'll also attach the prompt fragment and the exact curl command used. Thanks all :+1:
ops-bot: Deploy job queued: infra/eng-ml-kv-debug on dedicated-gpu-3 (ETA 12m)
Maya K.: I'll follow up with the full binary diff if we find kernel casting bug.
Samir P.: Update — initial q4_1 run didn't reproduce in 2 tries; q4_0 deterministic. Narrowing to q4_0 kernel.
Diego R.: Good, that narrows it. If you can capture a small snapshot state (kv buffers + tokens) right before wrap, that will let me reproduce locally. Any chance to dump buffer with `--kv-dump`?
Maya K.: Yes adding `--kv-dump` now to next run.
